verdict.rationale: Bland's first-party docs say agents can connect to any HTTP endpoint and take live actions mid-call. They also say pathways can execute webhooks at any point in the conversation, which covers the core of calling external APIs and custom functions during a call. missing for 10: evidence of latency handling or filler speech to avoid dead air while a tool runs, explicit documentation of the result being spoken back to the caller, independent or hands-on corroboration.
